alert.title: Weather alert — Gilgit-Baltistan, 14–15 Nov
alert.text: PMD advisory: rain, wind and thunderstorms with snow over the hills across Gilgit-Baltistan until the afternoon of Sat 14 Nov; isolated rain and mountain snow may linger in places. IMD: isolated to scattered rain/snow over GB on 14–15 Nov, with thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds (40–50 km/h, gusting to 60) possible — a yellow warning is in force for the region. Rain and snow may trigger landslides and slippery roads in the hills; check before travel. The spell eases after 15 Nov, with generally dry weather ahead.
alert.source: PMD advisory, 11 Nov 2026 · IMD forecast, 13 Nov 2026
